Name: Size
Description: Controls the overall scale of the rock formations. Higher values produce larger, more expansive rock features.

Name: Erosion
Description: Adjusts the amount of erosion applied to the rockscape, simulating natural weathering and smoothing of rock surfaces.

Name: Breakage
Description: Determines the degree of fracturing and splitting in the rocks, creating more jagged and broken surfaces as the value increases.

Name: Roughness
Description: Sets the surface roughness of the rocks, adding fine detail and texture to the formations.

Name: Jitter
Description: Introduces randomness to the placement and shape of rock features, making the rockscape appear more natural and less uniform.

Name: Clusters
Description: Controls the clustering behavior of rock formations, affecting how rocks group together or remain isolated.

Flubs.Name: Off
Flubs.Description: Disables clustering, resulting in evenly distributed rock features.

Flubs.Name: Large
Flubs.Description: Creates large clusters of rocks, forming prominent groupings and massifs.

Flubs.Name: Small
Flubs.Description: Generates small, tight clusters of rocks, producing scattered groupings across the surface.

Flubs.Name: Shattered
Flubs.Description: Simulates shattered rock formations, with highly fragmented and irregular clusters.

Name: Relief
Description: Specifies the style of surface relief, affecting the sharpness and layering of the rockscape.

Flubs.Name: Off
Flubs.Description: No additional relief is applied; the surface remains as generated by the base parameters.

Flubs.Name: Sharp
Flubs.Description: Applies sharp, pronounced relief, emphasizing angular features and steep transitions.

Flubs.Name: Soft
Flubs.Description: Applies soft, gentle relief, smoothing out transitions and creating a more weathered appearance.

Flubs.Name: Stratified
Flubs.Description: Adds visible stratification or layering to the rockscape, simulating sedimentary or banded rock formations.

Name: Seed
Description: Randomization seed for generating unique variations of the rockscape. Changing the seed produces different rock patterns.
